nodes.title: The marketing site names no teacher and uses no teacher pronoun: the child names the teacher (child-names-teacher), so the landing shows the three rig looks (teal, slate, plum B+ plates, rendered from the in-house rig, never generated art) unnamed, each labelled 'AI teacher', and sells the choice itself ('Your child picks the teacher, and names them'). This replaces §6.1.1's '{T} · AI teacher · classes 1–4' cast captions. Reversal: the owner fixes a launch cast with names that the child cannot change

The landing's lesson, Garden and parent-home pictures are REAL captured battery shots (docs/design/build/b1 desk work-your_turn b2 360, b2 map mid b2 360, b3-parent home 360 top 640), converted to 480-wide WebP under public/landing/ (14-23 KB each), in a plain device frame; the parent shot is desktop only (hidden and never fetched at 360). The How-do-we-know card is the parent format with sample data labelled 'Sample'. Reversal: re-capture when the Desk or the parent home changes visibly (V-SHOT re-baseline), never a mock-up

Landing hero (LCP) choreography: index.html preloads /assets/gen/manifest.json on '/' only (fetch preload, so the art ledger is not 3 round trips deep); the hero reads the full manifest row through the B2 loader (useArt gates existence) and serves the 360 phone crop at <= 600 px, the wide scene above, 1x/2x, fetchpriority high, over its LQIP, with no fade-in; the three rig faces mount only after the painting loads (or at once on the flat fallback, or after 2.5 s) at fetchpriority low, so they never compete with the LCP image. Reversal: the art ledger ships a per-route subset or the hero URL is known at build time (then drop the preload and the deferral)

scripts/lint-ui.mjs tells content from chrome by rule, not by blanket path exemptions (CONTENT table): a `lint-ui: speech` marker, a JSX line carrying data-speech, an engine's lesson-language triplet (tri(en, hinglish, hindi) or {english, hinglish, hindi}) under src/modules/frame/engines/** (TrayContent), and a Devanagari range inside a regex (/[ऀ-ॿ]/: code that detects the script). System notices in the frame (bootstrap.tsx) and the host (host.tsx) are chrome and became English-only in every lesson language. New rule L-HING: the §5.3 Hinglish wordlist (read from src/ui/copy.ts HINGLISH_CHROME, one source, plus kya/kaun/padhega found on Who) over visible strings in *.tsx. L-HOLD's TODO is upper-case only ('todo' = break in Hinglish). lint-ui is now a verify-release gate over the whole of src/. Reversal: a localisation layer replaces English-only chrome (owner-design-v2-directive reversal)

lint-ui over all of src/: 150 findings at B4 start (116 L-DEVA in module engine triplets, 2 L-DEVA + 1 L-HEX in host.tsx, 3 L-DEVA + 2 L-HOLD in frame bootstrap/placeValue, 1 L-DEVA regex in scene.tsx, 19 L-HEX in avatar Plate2D.tsx + avatar.css, 10 L-HEX in dev pages) → 0; the new L-HING rule then found 4 real/marking cases (Who.tsx 'Kaun padhega?', 'Kya tum … ho?', 'Haan', 'Nahi' as Young chrome; 2 unmarked speech lines) → 0. Method: node scripts/lint-ui.mjs, n = every .css/.ts/.tsx file under src/, 2026-10-03. The task brief's 264 had already fallen to 150 through other workstreams before B4 started

tests/e2e-design-b4-polish-site.mjs: 159/159 checks pass (V-SIG-2 0 lamp, V-EN-1, V-NAME-1, V-LAYOUT incl. CTA bottom <= 584 at 360x640, V-TGT >= 48 px, V-COPY no '!'/dash/teacher pronoun, V-ART ledger/fallback, V-STATES, V-MOTION, V-BRAND, V-PERF, L-UI with 9 lint controls and 4 DOM negative controls) over / /promises /privacy /help /leaving /404 at 360x640 DPR 2 and 1280x800, light and dark. Perf on '/' at 360, headless Chromium SwiftShader, n = 1 run per arm (3 earlier runs of the gzip arm: 2448/2432/2420 ms): unthrottled LCP 496 ms; Fast 3G (150 ms, 1.6 Mb/s) + 4x CPU as served by server/serve.mjs today (no compression) LCP 4364-4708 ms, FCP ~3.9 s, JS 412 KB raw; the same with a gzip proxy LCP 2412-2524 ms, FCP ~1.9 s, JS 135 KB, CSS 16 KB, fonts 72 KB, first-screen art 54 KB. JS+CSS requested by '/': 479 KB raw / 148 KB gzip, of which 36 KB gzip is useTeacher (TutorFace + tutors) pulled by main's eager child routes. Relative numbers only; the device lab owns absolute ones

Measuring the landing's bytes with page.route('**/api/**') active: Chromium's request interception disables the HTTP cache and preload matching, so the 95 KB art ledger was fetched twice (preload + loader) and the bytes looked 93 KB worse than reality. The perf arm now runs with no interception (serve.mjs answers /api/me for a signed-out visitor); CDP shows the second read at 0 bytes

A `.promise-detail { display: flex }` rule on an element toggled with the hidden attribute: the author rule beats the UA [hidden] rule, so every promise rendered expanded while its button said 'Read more' and aria-expanded=false; the battery's 'expands on click' check passed anyway. Found in the 360 screenshot. Fixed with `.promise-detail[hidden] { display: none }` and a 'starts collapsed' check for promises and FAQ

The brand mark is hand-drawn in code (src/app/landing/brand.mjs, one glyph: an open book whose spine rises into a pen nib with slit and breather hole, cream #F6F3EC on ink #24346E, no letters, no lamp, no yellow): public/favicon.svg, public/brand/{mark,app-icon,adaptive-foreground,adaptive-background,monochrome,splash-light,splash-dark}.svg, PNGs (192, 512, maskable 512, apple-touch 180, favicon 48, adaptive foreground and monochrome 432, splashes 1366) rendered in headless Chromium, and public/manifest.webmanifest. The Codex brand/* items stay pending and are not needed. Reversal: the owner prefers a Codex-painted mark (then brand.mjs keeps only the favicon)

The marketing site shows only the teachers a child can pick today: SITE_TUTORS = shared/tutors.js TUTORS with status 'live' (asha and arjun looks; uma is draft), drawn as the picker's own portrait (Plate2D still from the look: the same person as the lesson's tier D face and the lesson screenshot), unnamed, labelled 'AI teacher', aria-hidden inside a labelled group. The plates are code-drawn (no bytes), so they paint with the first frame and the hero no longer defers them. Supersedes the rig B+ plates (teal/slate/plum), which no other surface rendered (audit #4 regression). Battery V-FACE fails any [data-tutor] id outside the live catalogue and any /assets/teacher/ image on the site. Reversal: the in-house rig is wired into the picker and the lesson (task 16); the site then follows the catalogue automatically

Showing the in-house rig's three B+ plates (/assets/teacher/{teal,slate,plum}/plate/plate.webp) as 'the AI teachers your child can choose from' while the picker and the lesson still draw the shared/tutors.js looks: a parent saw one set of faces in the hero, a different face in the lesson screenshot one scroll later, and the second set again in the product (audit #4, S0: no stable teacher identity); the rig heads also read as unfinished. Caught by the fixer review, not the battery: nothing checked that a site face was a pickable face. Now V-FACE

Deviation from §6.1.1: the landing has no 'Hear a lesson' player. The only recorded clips (public/audio/hello-*.mp3) are the onboarding greeting 'I am Asha didi, a computer teacher', which gave the parent a fixed named female teacher under faces of both genders, contradicting child-names-teacher and the site's own no-name rule, and they are a greeting, not a lesson. The secondary CTA reads 'See a real lesson' (scrolls to the real lesson screenshot). Battery V-AUDIO: every clip the site can play must be in NO_NAME_CLIPS (empty). Reversal: no-name sample clips of a real lesson exchange exist in each lesson language, rendered in the live voices, with a transcript on the page (WCAG 1.2.1); add them to the registry and restore the player

Other §6.1.1 deviations, declared: (1) no 12 s rig clip in the hero (the rig is not the product's face yet: task 16); (2) no inline 'Hear {T}' at 1280 (no no-name clips; b4-site-no-hear-player); (3) the hero art is 200 dp tall at 360, not 280, so the CTA bottom stays above the 584 dp fold; (4) no offline 'cached shell' state: there is no service worker. Reversal: (1) rig wired into picker + lesson, (2) no-name clips exist, (3) a measured layout with 280 dp art that keeps the CTA above 584 dp, (4) a service worker ships (owner of the app shell)

Every site claim maps to something shipped: removed 'A weekly note comes on WhatsApp' (server/routes/parent.js: WhatsApp not wired); /help no longer says 'choose Forgot password?' (no reset exists; it now says a reset comes with phone-code sign-in and a forgotten password cannot be recovered from the page yet); 'the words AI teacher sit next to the teacher on every screen' became 'an AI label sits next to the teacher' (the lesson shows an 'AI' tag); 'names are checked: no real people' became 'checked against lists of public figures, unkind words and romance words' (what naming.js does); 'Got it' reads 'right on their own today' (Secure keeps 'later day'). Battery: V-COPY trips on WhatsApp, a catalogue teacher name (text, title, accessible names) and she/her/he/him/his outside the Riya sample card; V-STATES checks every site destination opens a real screen and every control /help names exists. Reversal: the feature ships (then the claim may return)

lint-ui content exemptions cover the content and nothing else: (a) data-speech exempts only the text inside the element carrying the attribute (or a self-closing one); the rest of the line is still tested; (b) `// lint-ui: speech` exempts exactly ONE string literal on its own line (no previous-line form; a marked line with two literals, e.g. a ternary of labels, is not exempt); (c) L-DEVA and L-HING now scan every .ts/.tsx under src/ except src/lesson, src/voice, dev/ folders and the dev pages, so string tables (copy.ts, strings.ts, the frame kit's W) are no longer invisible; (d) non-text Devanagari is stripped by shape: a regex character class holding Devanagari (range or danda) and a digits-only numeral table; string-literal union members are ids, not text. New CONTENT rules: kit/i18n.ts tri() lines (activity prompts and answer words) and useDesk.ts REQUESTS triplets (the child's words sent as a chip). The frame kit's controls and verdicts (Check, Start again, Play, Right, Not yet, one less, one more, delete, Your answer) and engine controls (geoboard Clear, multiplyDivide Add / Take all back) are English in every lesson language via chrome(). Supersedes the whole-line rules of b4-lint-content-vs-chrome. Reversal: a JSX-aware lint (TS AST) replaces the line rules

Whole-line content exemptions in lint-ui: a data-speech attribute anywhere on a line exempted the whole line, so `

{cap}

` gave 0 findings, and a `lint-ui: speech` comment exempted the NEXT line whatever it held (a ternary of Devanagari button labels). L-HING scanned only *.tsx and L-DEVA only *.tsx plus copy.ts, so 'Check karo', 'Phir se', 'Abhi nahi', 'mitao', 'Tumhara jawab' in src/modules/frame/kit/i18n.ts rendered as chrome in Hinglish and Hindi lessons while the gate read 0. The release gate could be met by adding a marker instead of fixing chrome. The battery's lint controls tested only the passing case; it now has negative controls for both bypasses and for .ts tables

Gating landing LCP on a gzip proxy the test itself created: server/serve.mjs (the production CMD) serves uncompressed, so the battery reported a pass for a server state that does not ship while production measured ~4.4 s, and the projection sat on the 2.5 s edge (single runs 2404-2524 ms) so it flapped. V-PERF now measures serve.mjs as shipped, median of n = 5, and records a KNOWN failure owned by the server (never counted as a pass, does not fail the exit code); the gzip arm is a reported projection

tests/e2e-design-b4-polish-site.mjs after the fixer: 180/180 checks pass plus 1 KNOWN failure (server). Landing at 360, headless Chromium, Fast 3G (150 ms, 1.6 Mb/s) + 4x CPU, n = 5 each: as shipped by serve.mjs LCP median 4392 ms (4400, 4344, 4336, 4412, 4392), FCP ~3.8 s, JS 405 KB transferred; gzip projection median 2424 ms (2456, 2392, 2404, 2464, 2424), JS 133 KB, CSS 16 KB, fonts 72 KB; unthrottled LCP 572 ms. JS+CSS requested by '/': 471 KB raw / 146 KB gzip (useTeacher 36 KB gzip still pulled by main's eager child routes). lint-ui over all of src/ with the widened scope: 45 findings → 0 (17 L-DEVA + 8 L-HING frame kit chrome fixed; REQUESTS, regex classes, numeral tables, a union type classified as content by rule; 2 Meet.tsx markers moved onto their lines). Relative numbers; the device lab owns absolute ones

The 2D plate's earring stud (src/avatar/Plate2D.tsx, presentedGender F) changed from gold #D9B45A to silver --face-stud #C7CBD1: the gold is 43 deg hue, inside the 12 deg lamp window, so it would put the lamp colour on every screen the teacher appears (G-LAMP-1). A look change in the avatar workstream's file, made by B4 for the lint: needs the avatar owner's confirmation (character-built-in-house). Reversal: the avatar owner picks a non-lamp gold that clears the lamp-hue check

Link previews: og:image is the absolute production URL of public/brand/share-1200x630.png (mark + 'Taxila' + the one-line promise, rendered by src/app/landing/brand.mjs), with og:url, og:image:width/height/alt and twitter:card; WhatsApp and Facebook scrapers do not resolve a relative og:image. Reversal: a custom domain replaces the Container Apps host (update og:url and og:image)

The site promises live in src/app/promises.ts (data only); Consent.tsx, the landing and Public.tsx import it, so the onboarding chunk no longer pulls the Public chunk and landing.css (whose global classes .phone .points .states .evidence .split .faq .eyebrow could collide). landing.css itself is not scoped under .site yet. Reversal: none needed; scope landing.css if a collision is ever measured

md.decisions:
## b4-site-no-teacher-name
src/app/landing/Landing.tsx (hero cast, 'picks the teacher' section), src/app/landing/Site.tsx (LOOKS, RigPortrait). V-COPY in the battery fails any he/she/him/his outside the sample child's evidence rows.

## b4-site-real-shots
public/landing/shot-{lesson,garden,parent}.webp. Captions are alt text describing the real screen.

## b4-hero-art-lcp
index.html inline preload; Site.tsx useArtEntry + HeroArt; Landing.tsx heroReady. The gzip arm of V-PERF is the gate (LCP <= 2.5 s on Fast 3G + 4x CPU); the uncompressed number is reported as a server-owner item.

## b4-lint-content-vs-chrome
scripts/lint-ui.mjs CONTENT, stripScriptRanges, L-HING, ALLOW (dev pages: L-HEX only). Controls live in tests/e2e-design-b4-polish-site.mjs (L-UI).

## b4-brand-mark
Re-run: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers node src/app/landing/brand.mjs. src/ui/Icon.tsx#Mark (the app shell's old book mark) is not yet the new glyph (src/ui owner).

## b4-site-faces-are-picker-looks
src/app/landing/Site.tsx SITE_TUTORS + TeacherPortrait (Plate2D still); Landing.tsx hero-cast and pick-cast. The rig plates under public/assets/teacher/ are left in place for task 16, unreferenced by the site.

## b4-site-no-hear-player
Landing.tsx header comment; battery V-AUDIO with NO_NAME_CLIPS.

## b4-site-spec-deviations
Landing.tsx hero; landing.css hero-art height.

## b4-site-claims-shipped-only
Landing.tsx (STATES, FAQ, parent section, pick note), promises.ts SITE_PROMISES[0], Public.tsx Help.

## b4-lint-scoped-exemptions
scripts/lint-ui.mjs stripContent, LANG_SCOPE, CONTENT, stripScriptRanges, visibleText; src/modules/frame/kit/i18n.ts chrome(). Controls: tests/e2e-design-b4-polish-site.mjs L-UI (18 cases) and tests/ui-v2-lint.test.mjs.

## b4-plate-stud-silver
src/styles/tokens.css --face-stud; src/avatar/Plate2D.tsx.

## b4-share-card
index.html og:*; brand.mjs SHARE_HTML.

## b4-promises-data-module
src/app/promises.ts; src/onboarding/Consent.tsx import.
